score_rationale: Every assignment acceptance criterion and every schema-level invariant I could machine-check at the frozen hash is met: 62 rows (threshold 15), all required fields populated, every class token one of the frozen four, every source_id resolving in both the registry and the citation audit, every row carrying a non-empty unresolved list, no duplicates, no accepted row resting on unverified or metadata-only evidence, and the frozen class-separation detector returns one lexical flag (T-402) that is regularity notation rather than a class merge. I independently re-fetched all four locators of the lead-reported independent spot checks (4/4 HTTP 200, title and author match, raw bytes retained) and independently reproduced the rubric's claim-scoped HF-01 detector. The score is 4.0 rather than 5.0 because three documented residuals are real and must travel with the artifact: the conclusion_type=theorem vocabulary collision on 30 rows, the absent source_meta scope fields, and a citation-audit corpus whose reviewer ESS is 1 (my four refetches corroborate 4 of 97 locators, not the whole audit).
hard_failure_note: No A0 critical detector fires at this hash. HF-01 is claim-scoped by its own detector text (evaluation_rubric.yaml:174), and ledger rows are not claim events, so its 30 hits are a vocabulary collision, not a firing; HF-02/HF-03/HF-05/HF-06 are contradicted by measured checks C3/C7/C6 and by the absence of any done-node claim in this task; HF-04 is not instantiable on the ledger schema because the quantity_check field it references does not exist anywhere in L0 (46/62 rows contain a quantity) - recorded as residual R4, not charged as a hard failure against rows that never carried the field.
findings: P1 PASS - assignment criterion 1 (class-token legality) is MET: 49 class_ids+informs_classes tokens across 62 rows, all four frozen values, zero extension tokens; non-class vocabulary (DEFINITIONS, WCC-STATEMENT, OTHER-MODELS, ...) sits in ledger_tags only. The lead-audit rev1 HF-02 (8 rows with DEFINITIONS inside class_ids) does not reproduce at ce42d205 (check C3).

P2 PASS - assignment criterion 2 (unresolved marking) is MET: 62/62 rows carry a non-empty unresolved list naming the resolving action; artifacts/literature/unresolved.jsonl (12 rows) binds only to existing theorem_ids, no orphans (check C8).

P3 PASS - assignment criterion 3 (>=3 independent re-fetch spot checks bind to the new ledger hash) is MET and independently corroborated: the controller's own l1_spotchecks scan finds 4 files citing ce42d205e761; the lead reports 4 independent + 4 corroborating + 2 DOI checks (artifacts/literature/reviews/L1-spotcheck-rev2.json, summary.independent_targets=4); I re-fetched the same four independent locators myself from a fresh process (SRC-002, SRC-004, SRC-057, SRC-059) and got 4/4 HTTP 200 with title and author matches, raw bytes hashed in artifacts/worker-011/l0_independent_review/refetch_report.json (check C12).

P4 PASS - the other two rev1 revise verdicts are addressed at this hash: the 24 unresolvable source_ids are 0 (C7), the near-duplicate title pairs are 0 (C9), the accepted-but-unverified contradiction is 0 (C6), T-301 retains the source's interior-data qualifier in statement_exact and assumptions, and its does_not_imply now states explicitly that it does not settle AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN for generic AF vacuum data (row T-301).

R1 MAJOR residual, non-blocking - conclusion_type vocabulary collision (flash-17 HF-01): 30 rows use conclusion_type=theorem with 0 rows carrying artifact_refs. I reproduced the rubric text: detector 'claim.conclusion_type == theorem AND (no artifact_refs ...)' is claim-scoped, so it does not fire on ledger rows; but a downstream consumer that reuses the claim vocabulary can misread these rows as protocol claims. Recommended rev-3 fix: add per-row source artifact_refs or rename the field (mathematical_result_kind) with a consumer audit. Deliberately deferred by the lead in L0-rev2-disposition.md section A.1; outside the frozen assignment acceptance list.

R2 MAJOR residual, non-blocking - source_meta scope fields (lead-audit rev1 HF-03) are absent: 0/97 registry rows and 0/62 ledger rows carry source_meta (dimension, matter_model, cosmological_constant, symmetry, formulation); I measured this myself rather than accepting the disposition (check C14). This is a real class-scope risk for machine consumers of the class mapping, but it is outside the frozen L0 acceptance list and is recorded as the lead's rev-3 backlog item 1.

R3 MAJOR residual - L1 evidence independence: ledger/citation_audit.csv has 97 rows and 2 reviewer labels (lead-literature 92, astra-lead-literature 5), i.e. Kish effective sample size 1; the L1 corpus is self-certified. My four live refetches corroborate 4 of 97 locators with 0 contradictions, which bounds but does not remove the residual. G-LIT should not treat citation_support as independently replicated until an independent audit pass covers the corpus.

R4 MAJOR scope ambiguity - rubric HF-04 (quantitative mismatch) has no claim. prefix and references a quantity_check evidence field that exists nowhere in the L0 schema; 46/62 rows contain a quantity in statement_exact and 0 carry quantity_check. Applied literally it would flag 46 rows, which is a rubric-vs-ledger schema mismatch rather than 46 defects. Recommended: scope the detector to claim objects or define the ledger's quantity-evidence field in rev 3.

R5 MEDIUM residual - T-301 class binding: the row remains in class_ids=[AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN] while its own does_not_imply says it does not settle that class, and the newer informs_classes field (7 rows: T-304, T-306, T-501, T-505, T-506, T-510, T-511) exists precisely for non-discharging relevance. Recommended rev-3 reclassification to class_ids=[] + informs_classes=[AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN]; non-blocking because the scope disclaimer is explicit and the conclusion_type is conditional_theorem, not theorem.

R6 MINOR - coverage annotation: 5 audit sources used by no ledger row (SRC-090, SRC-092, SRC-093, SRC-096, SRC-097). Not a defect in the rows; recorded so the coverage matrix is not read as exhaustive.

R7 MINOR - the C2 class has no discharging primary theorem (T-401 records this as a state-of-field finding, with Luk-Sbierski at preprint level); this is a property of the field at 2026-09-12, honestly recorded, and not an L0 defect.

S1 soft flag dispositioned - the frozen class-separation detector (research_map/class_separation.py#c266dbceca87) returns exactly one finding over the 62 rows: T-402.regularity = 'Between C^0 and C^2 (weak null singularity)'. Reading the row, C^0/C^2 are regularity degrees in a weak-null-singularity description, not class tokens, and the row is an open_problem spanning both classes; this is a lexical false positive on un-caret notation. Non-blocking; recommend 'C^0-C^2 regularity' in rev 3. The project's own audit_evidence.py reports no literature/classsep finding at this hash, which I reproduced read-only (1 hard finding, on claims[36], unrelated to L0).

NOTE - L0/L1 hash stability: ledger/theorems.jsonl and ledger/citation_audit.csv were unchanged throughout this review window (C13 drift guard, start=end hash). The lead deliberately froze ce42d205/315c1914 and requested blind review rather than rewriting again; that freeze is what makes this verdict bindable.
